<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move LEFT back to starting area
# Player at cols 50-51, need to go back to cols 20-21
# That's about 30 columns, or ~5 LEFT moves

for i in range(5):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    player = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    boundary = player['boundary']
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"LEFT {i+1}: player cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)} rows={min(rows)}-{max(rows)} greens={len(greens)}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
